validation_criterion: macro mean episode relative-motion RMSE3D on fixed validation outages
normalization: IMU dt-weighted mean/std on train flights only; delta/velocity fixed /5; cov standard deviation /10
imu_frame: published PX4 MAVROS body axes, ROS FLU; never rotate using GT
position_frame: published local ENU, common per-flight first ordinary GNSS origin
gt_point: PX4 IMU origin, authors dual RTK plus magnetometer reference
gnss_point: ordinary GNSS antenna; its lever arm to PX4 IMU is absent from supplied calibration

blockers: ordinary GNSS antenna to PX4 IMU lever arm not supplied
absolute initial yaw unavailable from permitted sensors without validated dynamic alignment
eskf.noise_status: engineering defaults for synthetic mechanization checks only; not tuned or asserted flight calibration
